ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In figure (a), the three-phase power supply terminals are labeled U, V, W from left to right, and are respectively connected to the motor M; the problem statement says that this wiring makes the motor rotate clockwise. In figure (b), there are likewise three wiring positions from left to right, but the three boxes above are empty and the phase sequence needs to be filled in. Reasoning: If a three-phase asynchronous motor is to reverse, it is only necessary to interchange any two phases. According to the given method, interchange the original left and middle phases U and V, while the right-side W remains unchanged. Therefore, the three boxes in figure (b) should be filled with V, U, W from left to right.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: in (a), the left, middle, and right supply positions are U, V, and W, and the text says this wiring gives clockwise rotation; in (b), the same three positions are blank. Apply the rule that a three-phase motor reverses direction when two phases are interchanged. Swap the left and middle labels of the original U, V, W while keeping the right label W unchanged. Therefore fill the boxes from left to right as V, U, W.

推理：三相异步电动机若要反转，只需将任意两相互换。按照给定方法，将原来的左、中两相 U 和 V 互换，右侧 W 保持不变。因此图(b)三个方框从左到右应填 V、U、W。
